what: Substances named in a standing withdrawal that a RULING permits to serve anyway. Keyed on substance, exactly as the withdrawal is. Every entry names the authority that granted it; an exception with no authority is not an exception, it is a row nobody has looked at.
andWHYTHEYAREPRINTEDEVERYRUN: an exception that stops being visible stops being a decision (R601). The door reports these on every run and never silently skips them.

exceptions.theRuling: MC04-FDP-04 and MC05-FDP-01 stay — ruled. The content ruling was later and made with both variants visible.
exceptions.theConflictItResolves: Cowork withdrew the SUBSTANCE; Annie restored the ROW from the population she verified in her 182nd. Two authorities over two different things, and this is the ruling that settles which governs.
exceptions.whatTheSendersNoticeSays: THIS ID SHIPPED WITH A STEM ITS OTHER COPY CONTRADICTS. Both variants have now crossed as bytes, shipped and unshipped named apart, and NOTHING CHOSE BETWEEN THEM.
exceptions.andWHATISDIFFERENTNOW: something chose. The unchosen variant is retained on the row itself, so the choice is inspectable rather than remembered.
